gates.evidence: Proposal targets general AI task assistance and uses SFW interactions with Game Partner Luzia.
Rewards task access for playing a mini-game; no rewards for clicks, installs, or cash-like items.
Uses gain framing ('Play a quick game... to unlock') without dark patterns or loss tactics.
Requires explicit tap on 'Play Now' button before the mini-game starts.
Clearly states the reward (1 task access) and required action (15s game with Luzia) beforehand.
Includes an equally legible decline option ('No thanks') that returns the user without penalty.
Appears at the subscription/account wall (s07) when attempting a task, never mid-stream.
Explicitly restricted to non-paying, logged-out users hitting the subscription wall.

scores.evidence: Proposal targets moment m1 (subscription wall on s07 when starting a task) and rewards task access (r3) right at the point of need.
Triggers at the subscription wall rather than interrupting chat flow, preserving native experience.
Capped at 2 per day, restricted to non-payers at the wall, keeping the subscription as the superior path.
Code computed cost to serve ($0.0090) exceeding net revenue per view ($0.0063) at the low end.
Tied to starting a task from the Services Tab, which is a frequent core activity.
Maps directly to SIM-RWD with button entry, Game Partner Luzia, and 15s play threshold.
Cites screen s07, s06, resources r1 and r3, and uses Luzia as Game Partner from digest nouns.
Includes explicit caps of 2 per day, a 30-minute cooldown, and decline options.
Defines primary metric, guardrails, and a 10% user-level holdout group.
